subject: literacy
concept: Reading with appropriate pace — not too slow (word-by-word) and not so fast that accuracy suffers
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading fluency-building sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student echo-reads a short passage after the persona models an appropriate pace
exercise.pictorial: Student practices reading the same short passage multiple times, noticing increased smoothness
exercise.abstract: Student reads a short decodable passage aloud at an appropriate pace

assessment.mastery_threshold: reads passage with reasonable pace and at least 90% word accuracy
misconception_flags: reads so fast that words are skipped or garbled
reads word-by-word without any natural phrasing

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile, using only decodable vocabulary
